A passing comparison is a conditional model claim under the frozen v6 calibration; it is not evidence that A1 passed, calibration is identified, real-world blend performance is validated, or operational approval exists.

unchanged_protocol.engine: Trent 1000-AE3 inputs (ICAO 02P23RR126: OPR, BPR, rated thrust); SELECTED v6 fitted parameters (outputs/phase7/calibration_v6.json) held fixed for all fuels and all draws; single-zone equilibrium combustor; analytic turbine and nozzle

CLIMB85.eta_b: TAKE-OFF value of the same draw (convention; no ICAO climb data in the CSV)

fuels.basis: MASS fractions of registered surrogates via simulation.fuels_v7.mass_blend (mole fractions for Cantera). Not volumetric certification limits; no operational approval implied.
fuels.neat_context: HEFA-100, FT-100, ATJ-100 (context only, published separately)

quantities: nox_corr_g_s (ICAO-derived correlation of OPR and fuel flow, calibration-group fit; no fuel-composition term: blend NOx differences follow fuel flow only)

draws.source: outputs/p62_bands_v5.csv rows draw_00..draw_63 (the 64 P6.2 fixed-parameter draws, seed 42)
draws.used_columns: fixed_combustor_pressure_loss, fixed_eta_compressor, fixed_eta_turbine_polytropic, fixed_fpr_rated, fixed_eta_fan, fixed_eta_b_{TAKE-OFF,APPROACH,IDLE}
draws.not_used: the per-draw REFITTED v5 parameters (fit_* columns)
draws.pairing: the same draw is applied to every fuel, so each paired difference uses common draws
draws.label: conditional fixed-calibration sensitivity bands; NOT refit-conditioned P6.2 bands; NOT statistical confidence intervals

pairs.pathway_like_fraction: at each of 10,20,30,50: HEFA vs FT, HEFA vs ATJ, FT vs ATJ (12 pairs)
pairs.context_neat_pathway: HEFA-100 vs FT-100, HEFA-100 vs ATJ-100, FT-100 vs ATJ-100 (3 pairs; context, separate)
pairs.denominator: relative difference = delta / Q(b) central (b = JetA for SAF-vs-JetA and neat-vs-JetA; b = the second-named pathway at the same fraction for pathway pairs)
pairs.spread: S(point, quantity) = |Q(JetA_dooley2012) - Q(JetA_dooley2010)| central, at unchanged v6 calibration, same point and quantity, absolute units

claim_rule: CLAIMED iff all hold: (i) operating point in the calibration domain (TAKE-OFF, APPROACH, IDLE; CLIMB85 never)
(ii) every one of the 64 draws converged for both fuels at that point
(iv) at least 95 % of the 64 paired draw differences agree in sign with the central difference (>= 61 of 64; a zero paired difference counts as disagreement)
(vi) lifecycle_g_s only: additionally >= 95 % sign agreement over the 1000 CORSIA common scenario draws at the central cycle
All comparisons are published with pass/fail and reasons, including neat context (separate family).

lifecycle.formula: lifecycle g/s = ff [kg/s] * sum_i mass_i * LHV_i [MJ/kg] * LCEF_i [gCO2e/MJ] (energy-weighted mixture LCEF; component contributions)
lifecycle.LCEF: data/corsia_lca_values.yaml (CORSIA Doc 06, same sources as P6.3): fossil baseline 89 gCO2e/MJ for Jet A (both Jet A surrogates); SAF pathways central = triangular mode
lifecycle.scenario_draws: 1000 common draws, numpy default_rng(42), triangular(min, mode, max) per pathway in the P6.3 order (HEFA, FT, ATJ per draw)
lifecycle.LHV_basis: LIQUID basis for lifecycle: LHV_i = gas-phase CRECK LHV of component surrogate i (298.15 K, H2O vapour) minus 0.360 MJ/kg. The 0.360 is the n-dodecane heat of vaporisation (NIST) applied to EVERY species -- a common approximation, not a species-specific value. The thermodynamic cycle stays on the gas-phase basis (species enthalpies; no vaporisation), so the correction is applied exactly once, only in the lifecycle energy conversion. P6.3 used gas-phase LHVs; P7.3 values are therefore not directly comparable with P6.3 lifecycle numbers.

nvpm.relation: Brem et al. (2015) via Teoh et al. (2022) SI Eq. S1 only (CAEP/11 form excluded by P7-A1)
nvpm.hydrogen: H_blend = 13.8 + f_SAF * (15.30 - 13.8), linear in SAF mass fraction (reference values, not surrogate hydrogen)
nvpm.validity: strict: F > 30 % AND 0 <= dH < 0.6. 10/20/30 % blends at take-off (and 85 % climb) are inside; 50 % (dH 0.75) and neat SAF (dH 1.5) exceed the hydrogen interval -> status 'unavailable', no number; approach (F = 30, not > 30) and idle -> unavailable
nvpm.output: percent change in nvPM number EI vs the Jet A reference; screening only; take-off and extrapolated-engine-condition 85 % climb; not validated engine nvPM; no absolute EI (no measured baseline); no CO2-to-nvPM equivalence; not subject to the claim rule (pathways share one hydrogen reference, so pathway differences are zero)

labels: Conditional fixed-calibration sensitivity over the 64 P6.2 fixed-parameter draws with v6 parameters frozen; not refit-conditioned P6.2 bands; not confidence intervals.

Fuel-representation spread S = Dooley 2012 vs Dooley 2010 at v6: a sensitivity measure, not a complete uncertainty bound. Dooley 2012 fails the P7.1 hydrogen and aromatics checks; its target fuel is POSF 4658, the check target POSF 10325.
Mass-basis blends; not volumetric certification limits; neat SAF is contextual; no operational approval implied.
NOx is the ICAO-derived correlation of OPR and fuel flow (calibration-group fit); it has no fuel-composition term.
Lifecycle uses liquid-basis LHVs (one n-dodecane vaporisation correction for all species); the cycle uses gas-phase enthalpies.
nvPM: Brem (2015) relation only, screening at take-off and extrapolated 85 % climb; unavailable outside F > 30 % and dH < 0.6; no absolute EI; no CO2-to-nvPM equivalence.
CLIMB85 is an extrapolated operating point (no ICAO climb data in the CSV; eta_b = take-off value).

study_parity.central: Every original central fuel, including alternative JetA spread reference, at TAKE-OFF, APPROACH, IDLE and CLIMB85.
study_parity.draw_fuels: Every original sensitivity-study fuel (all fuel_parts except JetA_dooley2010), at all four operating points; fixed parameters from each named original draw.

study_parity.required_result: PASS for every comparison; no tolerance change or cherry-picked removal. Failure prevents full blend stage and retains evidence.
study_parity.limitation: Other 61 draws are not cross-backend recomputed by this subset. All 64 are still required in the actual conditional study; missing/unconverged rows fail the original comparison rule.

operational_guards.active_chain: Do not interrupt, signal, reorder or integrate scientific source changes into the active main AC workflow. No P7.3 stage is inserted into its registration.
operational_guards.required_main_evidence: Strict registered benchmark queue completions, benchmark owner release, referenced stage dependencies/output/log hashes, matching terminal chain, no lease, validation_build PASS and its actual binary hash. Terminal FAIL/INCOMPLETE remains truthful and never substitutes for required PASS evidence.

binary_selection.rule: Explicitly preload and verify the selected module path/hash in the parent and every worker, equal to validated PASS validation_build and fresh G0. Preserve cpp/build benchmark binary. No implicit sys.path preference, CATJET_BUILD-only assumption or fallback.

operational_guards.resources: Require AC immediately before every heavy stage, caffeinate and nice -n 15; no overlapping owned heavy stage. Revalidate dependencies/resource/ownership/binary after every wait and immediately before launch.
operational_guards.ownership: Use record-backed exclusive reservation/lease with PID plus birth/argv handshake; never process-name matching or owner death as completion. Hold ownership for parity/full study/postprocessing until terminal record publication.
operational_guards.drift: Freeze source/input/registration/config/environment/binary identity before launch; verify again after compute and before terminal publication. Unreadable identity or drift yields ERROR/nonzero exit and retained evidence, never accepted PASS/COMPLETE.
operational_guards.failure: Prerequisite failure is BLOCKED before work; parity mismatch is FAIL; exception/drift/missing expected outputs is ERROR or INCOMPLETE with nonzero exit. Comparison-rule rejections/unconverged rows are preserved quantitative findings, never fabricated successful solves.
operational_guards.source_integration_caveat: The main validator compares the entire registered tracked-source set. Adding a consumer/test there after the chain may invalidate current identity against terminal evidence. Before any execution, either run the additive implementation from a separately frozen isolated worktree while preserving and validating the unchanged main root and its actual binary, or register a precise additive identity-extension protocol prospectively. Never waive source checks or silently reuse stale terminal records.
